original: tatra sarvaśrāddhāni trividhāni – navaśrāddhāni navamiśrāṇi purāṇānīti | tatra mṛtāhādyekādaśāhāntaṃ vihitāni navaśrāddhāni | ekādaśāhādinyūnābdāntaṃ vihitāni navamiśrāṇi | tataḥ paraṃ purāṇānīty uktam | tatra sarvaikoddiṣṭeṣu daivaṃ nāsti | eka uddeśyo brāhmaṇaś caikaḥ | ayugmā vā brāhmaṇāḥ | ekaṃ pātraṃ pavitraṃ ca | bhuktaśeṣeṇaikaḥ piṇḍo deyaḥ | purāṇaikoddiṣṭe pārvaṇaikadeśavat sarvaṃ daivahīnaṃ samantrakam eva | pāṇau mantrābhyāṃ homaḥ | navamiśreṣu divā nimantraṇam | nimantraṇādi na svādhyāyaḥ | pitṛśabdasvadhānamaḥśabdavatāṃ mantrāṇāṃ lopaḥ | tilāvāpādi sarvaṃ tūṣṇīṃ kāryam | tūṣṇīm arghyaṃ nivedyān āvāhya mantrānte nāmnā pretoddeśeṇārghyaṃ datvā gandhādi deyam | pāṇau pretāya svāhety ekāhutiḥ | navaśrāddheṣu dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ svadhāśabdaṃ pitṛśabdaṃ piṇḍe ‘nuśabdaṃ japam abhiśravaṇaṃ ca varjayet | akṣayyasthāna upatiṣṭhatām iti vadet | prativacanaṃ tadvat | abhiramyatām iti visarjayet | abhiratāḥ sma iti pratyuktiḥ | navamiśre ca sarvaṃ samantrakam ity eke | navaśrāddhe sarvam amantrakam eva kāryam | nāmapretaśabdaṃ ca na lopayet | sadya eva nimantraṇam | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ śrāddhaśeṣabhojanaṃ ca varjayet | navaśrāddhaṃ kṛtvā snāyāt | anyat sarvaṃ pārvaṇavat | navaśrāddhāny ekādaśe ‘hni vā kāryāṇi | tatrādyaṃ sahaikoddiṣṭam | tatra bahudakṣiṇā pretavastrābharaṇayānaśayyāsanabhojana-pādukopanacchatrādikaṃ deyam | rudragaṇe pretoddiṣṭapakṣe navaśrāddhavat | rudroddeśapakṣe tu yajñopavītī viprān samabhyarcya bhojayet | rudrarūpapretoddeśavac chrāddhaṃ sodakumbhaṃ satilaṃ sarvatra dakṣiṇā deyā pretaśrāddhe viśeṣeṇa |

original: tatra vipro viprasya daśakumbhaṃ dhānyaṃ vā tatparimitaṃ taṇḍulādi vā tāmrarajatādikam amatyā hṛtvā traimāsikaṃ kuryāt | matyābhyāse kṛcchrābdam | kṣatriyāder hartuḥ pādapādahrāsaḥ | kṣatriyasvaṃ vipro hṛtvā ṣāṇmāsikam | vaiśyasve traimāsikaṃ śūdrasve cāndram | evam uttaratrāpy ūhyam | kumbhaḥ pañcasahasrapalaparimāṇaḥ | viprasya gṛhakṣetrabhūmi[115]nikṣeparajatavajramaṇīnāṃ narāśvastrīṇāṃ ca sārdhaśatadvayapaṇalabhyapāṇīyarasavāpīkūpajalānāṃ ca hartur viprasya suvarṇasteyasamavat | kṣatrādisve cāndratadardhapādādi | trapusīsādidravyāṇām alpaprayojanānāṃ sārdhaśatadvayaṃ paṇapañcadaśārdhānāṃ hartuḥ sāntapanam | bhakṣyabhojyāhārapānādīnām ekavārabhojanaparyāptānāṃ pānaśayyāsanānāṃ puṣpamūlaphalānāṃ ca hartuḥ pañcagavyenāhorātram | trivārabhojanaparyāpte trirātram | tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāṃ trivārabhojanaparyāptamūlyārghyāṇāṃ śuṣkānnaguḍatailacarmamāṃsānāṃ ca hartus trirātram | maṇimuktāpravālatāmrarajatāyaḥkāṃsyopalānāṃ ca dvādaśāhāraparyāptamūlyānāṃ hartur dvādaśāhakaṇānnatvam | kārpāsakīṭajorṇānāṃ dvikhuraikakhurarajjupakṣigandhauṣadhīnāṃ trivārabhojanaparyāptamūlyārghyāṇāṃ hartuḥ payas tryaham | sarvatra hriyamāṇadravyālpatvabahutvābhyāṃ prāyaścittālpatvamahattve kalpye | sarvasteyaprāyaścittadravyaṃ svāmine sati datvaiva kāryam |

original: tatrāmatyā parivettā cāndrādiṣv ekaṃ kṛtvā jyeṣṭhāya svoḍhāṃ striyaṃ datvā tenānujñātāṃ tām evodvahet | matyā cet tatrāpi kanyāpitrādyajñāne ‘bdaṃ kāryam | brāhmaṇagṛhabhaikṣāśanaṃ ca kṛtvaivaṃ kuryāt | kanyāpitrādidattodvāhe traimāsikam | kṛcchrātikṛcchrau vā kṛtvaiva kuryāt | parivedyasya tu dve kṛcchre kanyāyāḥ kṛcchro dātur atikṛcchro hotuś cāndram | evaṃ parivedyavat paryāhitaparījyaparivittānāṃ kāyadvayam | parivettṛparivittaparyādhātṛ-pariyaṣṭragredidhiṣūparividhiṣūpatīnāṃ cābdaṃ gautamokataṃ brahmacaryaṃ kṛtvā paścād vivāhaḥ | agredidhiṣūpatiḥ kṛcchraṃ kṛtvā tām evodvahet | didhiṣūpatis tu kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kṛtvā tasmai datvānujñātaḥ punas tām evodvahet | yad vāgredidhiṣūpatiḥ kāyaṃ kṛtvā tām eva jyeṣṭhāṃ paścād anyenoḍhām udvahet | didhiṣūpatis tu kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kṛtvā svoḍhāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ kanīyasyāḥ pūrvavoḍhre datvānyām udvahet | jyeṣṭhe sthite kaniṣṭhaḥ kṛtavivāhaḥ parivettā parivividānaś ca sa jyeṣṭhaḥ parivittiḥ parivedyāś ca saḥ | parivibhāgavettṛparivibhāgavittyādeś caivam | jyeṣṭhāyāṃ kanyāyām anūḍhāyām anujoḍhā cet sāgredidhiṣūḥ pūrvā didhiṣūḥ | bhṛtakādhyāpako bhṛtakādhyāpitaś ca payasā brāhmīṃ suvarcalāṃ trīn pakṣān niyataḥ pibet | cāndrādiṣv ekaṃ vā kuryāt | anuyogapradāne caivam | utkarṣahetor adhīyānasya kiṃ paṭhasi nāśitaṃ tvayety evaṃ paryanuyogo ‘nuyogapradānam | anuyogapradānābhyāse pātityam āhuḥ |

original: tatrocchiṣṭabhakṣaṇe tāvac chavakākādipakṣiśvāpadākhubiḍālanakulocchiṣṭe bhūyasy annarase jagdhe keśādyavapanne ca devadroṇyādau dravyasaṃskārarahite vāmatyā ced brāhmīṃ suvarcalām ekarātraṃ pibet | matyā cet trirātram | alpadravye ced amatyābhyāse ‘tikṛcchraḥ | matyābhyāse pakṣaṃ yāvakaṃ vratam | brahmakṣatriyavaiśyaśudrocchiṣṭe tu brāhmaṇa ekatripañcasaptarātrāṇi pañcagavyaṃ pibet | abhyāse ‘py eṣām āvṛttiḥ | matyā bhojane tu tāny eva śuddhopavāsādīni kuryāt | matyābhyāse kāyātikṛchrataptakṛcchracāndrāṇi | kṣatrādau pādaṃ hrāsayet | bhāṇḍasthe ‘nne keśapipīlikāmedhyasevikīṭair upahate tāvanmatram uddhṛtya bhasmatāmravaiḍūryahiraṇyarajatādibhir govālair darbhayuktena vāriṇā śeṣaṃ prokṣayet | hastastham evaṃbhūtaṃ tyajet | mukhasthaṃ [133] niṣṭhīvya ghṛtaṃ prāśnīyāt | manuṣyareto-viṇmūtrabhakṣaṇe varṇās taptakṛcchrātikṛcchrakāyatrirātrāṇi kuryuḥ | matyā cāndrataptakṛcchra-kāyān pūnaḥsaṃskāraṃ ca | alehyāpeyacāṇḍālādyantyānne caivam | caṇḍālaḥ śvapākaḥ kṣattā sūtro vaidehako māgadha ityādyā antyāḥ | tadannabhojanae caivam | antyānāṃ bhaktaśeṣaṃ bhuktvā varṇā yaticāndraṃ kāyaṃ tadardhaṃ pādaṃ ca kuryuḥ | antyocchiṣṭabhakṣaṇe tu cāndraṃ mahāsāntapanaṃ ṣaḍrātraṃ trirātraṃ ca kuryuḥ | abhyāse ‘tyabhyāse vā dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ nirantare patanam | āmagrahe tv ardham | taducchiṣṭabhojane dviguṇam | sahabhojane ccicuṇam (triguṇam?) | matyābhyāse patanam | dīpocchiṣṭatailaṃ rātrau rathyādūṣitaṃ cābhyaṅgaśiṣṭaṃ ca bhuktvā naktaṃ caret | pītāvaśiṣṭamukhanirgatapāne matyābhyāse cāndraṃ parākaṃ vā kuryāt | pīvāvaśiṣṭamātrapāne vāmahastena ca pāne tadardham |
analyzed: tatra ucchiṣṭa bhakṣaṇe tāvat śava kāka ādi pakṣi śvāpada ākhu biḍāla nakula ucchiṣṭe bhūyasi anna rase jagdhe keśa ādi avapanne ca devadroṇī ādau dravya saṃskāra rahite vā amatyā ced brāhmīm suvarcalām eka rātram pibet matyā ced tri rātram alpa dravye ced amatya abhyāse tikṛcchraḥ matya abhyāse pakṣam yāvakam vratam brahma kṣatriya vaiśya śudra ucchiṣṭe tu brāhmaṇaḥ eka tri pañca sapta rātrāṇi pañcagavyam pibet abhyāse pi eṣām āvṛ
atha aśuci dravya saṃspṛṣṭa bhakṣaṇe

dvitīye dvyahaṃ tṛtīye ‘horātraṃ parato naktam | aprāyatye rajodṛṣṭau bālāpatyāyā abhiṣekād bhuktiḥ | mṛtasūtakasaṃparka ṛtuṃ spṛṣṭvā snānakālān nāśnīyāt | matyā bhuktvā cāndram | caṇḍālādisaṃkare | caṇḍālādyambupāne kāyaṃ tadardhaṃ vā | caṇḍālādisaṃspṛṣṭāmbupāne gomūtrayāvakaṃ trirātram | bhuktvocchiṣṭasya caṇḍālādisparśane kāyam | yad vā gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ sahasram aṣṭaśataṃ vā japitvā trirātrānte pañcagavyaṃ pibet | āmabhakṣocchiṣṭe pādaḥ | adhaḥsthānocchiṣṭaś cāṇḍālādispṛṣṭaḥ pādam | cāṇḍālādispṛṣṭau mūtrotsarge trirātram upoṣya jātavedasaṃ vā japet | amatyāśaktasya tūpavāsaḥ | bhojane ṣaḍrātram | āmabhakṣaṇe trirātraṃ prāṇāyāmaśataṃ vā | rajakādiviṣaye cāṇḍālādyuktārthaṃ jñeyam | ucchiṣṭaḥ śvādīñ chūdramadyāmedhyādyaspṛśyān spṛṣṭvopoṣya pañcagavyaṃ pibet | rajasvalāsūtikāmedhyapatitacāṇḍālapulkasāvadhūtakuṇṭhahastakṛmikuṣṭhikunakhyaspṛśyāśauci-saṃspṛṣṭānnaṃ matyā bhuktvā kāyam amatyārdham | asaddravye keśādyavapanne ca kuśaśaṅkhapuṣpādikaṣāyaṃ brāhmīṃ vā pibet | śūdreṇa pakvaṃ vāmedhyasevikīṭopahataṃ ca bhuñjāne śūdrasparśe cānarhasahapaṅktau vā bhuktāñjāneṣu vā yatrocchiṣṭaṃ prayacched ācāmed vā kutsitvā vā yaṣṭānnaṃ dadyād ucchiṣṭapaṅktau vā ca viṇmūtrādibhir atyantopahate ca pāne ca varṇās tridvyekopavāsanaktāni kuryuḥ pañcagavyāśanaṃ ca | tatraiva klinnabhinnaśavayukte ‘mbupāne tu matyātikṛcchraḥ | tādṛṅmānuṣaśavayukte [135] tu matyā cāndrāyaṇam | cāṇḍālādisaṃbaddhakūpādyalpajalāśayeṣv ambu pītvā snātvā tadbhāṇḍasthaṃ vā matyā varṇāḥ sāntapanaṃ kāyaṃ tadardhaṃ pādaṃ kramāc careyur amatyā tadardham | aśaktaḥ pañcagavyaṃ pibet | mahājalāśaye na doṣaḥ | hradapuṣkariṇyādiṣu jānudadhne na doṣaḥ | tato ‘dhastane tv amatyā naktaṃ matyopavāsaṃ vipraḥ kuryāt | rajakādyantyajakūpabhāṇḍasthāmbupayodadhipāne tv amatyā dvijā brahmakūrcena tridvyekopavāsān kuryuḥ | śūdras tūpavāsaṃ śaktyā dānaṃ ca | matyā taddviguṇam | antyajaiḥ khānitavāpīkūpataḍāgādiṣu snāne pāne copavāso matyābhyāse kāyam | madhyameṣu pañcagavyam | analyzed: tatra keśa kīṭa ādi avapanne nīlī lākṣā snāyu asthi carma rakta māṃsa vasā majjā surā śukra viṣ mūtra saṃspṛṣṭe mahāpāpa avekṣite duṣṭa pakṣi ucchiṣṭe viḍvarāha ādi ucchiṣṭe gavā āghrāte śuṣke paryuṣite vṛthāpakve deva pitṛ artha anne homa artheṣu ca amatyā bhakṣaṇe pāne ca upavāsaḥ pañcagavyam ca sarvatra matyā ca pāda ardha kṛcchraḥ avijñāta jāti asthi ādi dūṣite tad ardham karṇa viḍa ādi mala ṣaṭke tu ardha
atha bhāva duṣṭa bhakṣaṇe

original: tatra nijavarṇādirahitaṃ bhāvaduṣṭam | bhāvaduṣṭe ‘nne bhāvaduṣṭe ca bhojane matyā trirātram amatyārdham | chardane ghṛtaprāśanam | bhakṣyābhakṣyaśaṅkitabhakṣaṇe tv akṣāralavaṇe rūkṣāṃ brāhmīṃ suvarcalāṃ pibet trirātram | śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ vā payasā saha kuśapadmodumbarapalāśabilvapatrāmbupakvaṃ vā pibet | saṃvatsarasya trīn dvāv ekaṃ kṛcchraṃ caret | śaṅkāyāṃ vijñāne taddviguṇaṃ dvijaś caret |
analyzed: tatra nija varṇa ādi rahitam bhāva duṣṭam bhāva duṣṭe nne bhāva duṣṭe ca bhojane matyā tri rātram amatyā ardham chardane ghṛtaprāśanam bhakṣya abhakṣya śaṅkita bhakṣaṇe tu a kṣāra lavaṇe rūkṣām brāhmīm suvarcalām pibet tri rātram śaṅkhapuṣpīm vā payasā saha kuśa padma udumbara palāśa bilva patra ambu pakvam vā pibet saṃvatsarasya trīn dvau ekam kṛcchram caret śaṅkāyām vijñāne tad dviguṇam dvijaḥ caret

original: atha yas tūddhato mahāpāpaprāyaścittam na kuryāt tasya patitasya sarve sapiṇḍā bāndhavāś ca riktātithau sāyāhne grāmād bahir apāṃ pūrṇaṃ dāsyāhṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ prācīnāvītino muktaśikhā gurusaṃnidhāv asmākaṃ tvaṃ mṛta iti ninayeyuḥ | [144] tato ‘nirīkṣamāṇā apa upaspṛśya grāmaṃ praviśeyuḥ | tatas taṃ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇādiṣu varjayet | yadi pramādāt saṃbhāṣaṇādi kṛtam amatyā sāvitrīṃ japann ekarātraṃ tiṣṭhet |  matyā trirātram | abhyāse ‘bde pātityam | atha kṛtaprāyaścitta āgate sapiṇḍās tena saha puṇye jale snātvāpāṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ puṇye deśe kale ca puṇyadiṅmukhās tvam asmākam iti ninayeyuḥ | tataḥ sa gobhyo yavasaṃ datvā bhakṣite śuddhaḥ | na cet punaḥ prāyaścittaṃ caret sa vyavahāryaś ca | strīṇāṃ patitānāṃ caivaṃ tyāgaḥ prigrahaś ca kiṃ tu pradhānagṛhasamīpe kuṭīṃ kṛtvā prāṇadhāraṇārtham annaṃ malinaṃ vāsaś ca datvā bhogarahitāṃ rakṣet | strīṇām api mahāpāpādipāpānupāpāny abhyastāni copapāpāni patananimittāni | viśeṣato hīnavarṇagamanaṃ garbhapātanam abrāhmaṇyā api bhartur hiṃsanaṃ tāni patanahetūni | śiṣyagāgurugājuṅgitopagatānām apy evaṃ prāyaścittam | kṣatriyādeḥ prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇam antare kṛtvā brūyāt | strīśūdrāṇāṃ japahomavarjaṃ vācyam | amantrakāḥ prāṇāyāmāḥ sarvatra vācyā eva | yāgādyanuṣṭhānaśīlānuśīlānāṃ japādikam | itareṣāṃ tu japādi | nāmadhārakamūrkhanirdhanānāṃ tapa evānadhīyānāṃ ca | kartṛvyatiriktair vijñātadoṣo vikhyātadoṣaḥ | sa vidvān api śīghraṃ parṣadanumataṃ vrataṃ prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt | tatra vedadharmajñā viprāḥ sahasrādyekāntā yāvanto yathāyogyaṃ parṣady ativarjam | parṣaddakṣiṇā ca lakṣagavādi kiṃcidantaṃ yathāyogyaṃ kṛcchrasaṃkhyā vā | parṣattuṣṭir vā | tatra sakṛd āplutya sacailo vāgyataḥ snātvārdravāsāḥ parṣaddakṣiṇāṃ datvā pāpaṃ vyākhyāya prāyaścittaṃ tadvratam ādāya punaḥ snātvā vrataṃ caret | parṣac ca brūyāt | na cet tatsamā syāt | ajñātvā vadec cet tat pāpaṃ sarvam āpatet | parṣanmataṃ vinā kurvan dviguṇaṃ kuryāt | keśarakṣārthaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ caret | vidvadviprastrīṇāṃ vapanaṃ neṣyate |

analyzed: tatra kartṛ vyatiriktaiḥ a vijñāta doṣaḥ rahasya prāyaścittam caret a vidvān tu mukha antareṇa rahasya prāyaścittam jñātvā rahaḥ caret strī śūdrān ca evam japa homa varjam tatra āhāra viśeṣa anuktau payaḥ prabhṛtayaḥ kāla viśeṣa anuktau saṃvatsara ādayaḥ deśa viśeṣa anuktau śiloccaya ādayaḥ gautama uktāḥ tatra japeṣu ṛṣi daivata chandaḥ viniyogāḥ vijñeyāḥ amatyā brāhmaṇa vadhe naśnan tri rātram antar jale magnaḥ ṛtam ca satyam
